screenshot_note: Full-page screenshot capture failed; the assessment below is from the rendered DOM and markdown extraction.
strengths: Real project photography — roughly 40 unique job photos on /our-work.
Genuine team page with photos, names and roles for seven people.
Live Google-syndicated review widget showing 5.00 across 69 reviews.
Wide service-area coverage already built out (25 city pages).
weaknesses: Homepage runs the SAME 'About Us' block twice — once written for Indianapolis and once for Plainfield. It is a visible copy-paste error.
Body font resolves to Times New Roman with a 61px computed body size; heading sizes are 23px. Type hierarchy is inverted.
The review widget dumps raw markup into the page — addresses, phone numbers and review timestamps render as loose text.
Copy is near-identical across service pages; the stamped-concrete page still tells visitors to 'choose us for all your concrete broom finish needs'.
Contact and pricing pages are dominated by a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge and a full country-code list rendered as visible page text.
Privacy and Terms link off-domain to find.bestlocalcontractor.online.
No structured data, no llms.txt, no per-service FAQ schema.
verdict: Content and photography are strong. The delivery is the problem: duplicated blocks, broken type scale, leaking widget markup and templated per-service copy. A rebuild keeps the assets and fixes the shell.
